messages.充電回数を10以上貯めてS3「サイの突進」を撃ち、出血回数を一気に増やすのが本領: A durable Bleed enabler whose main payoff is building at least 10 Charge Count, then using S3 Rhino Ram to add a large amount of Bleed Count.
messages.S3で出血回数を大量付与: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインはそれぞれ的中時に出血回数+1。さらに充: **Mass Bleed Count with S3**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each add +1 Bleed Count on hit. They also spend 2 Charge Count for +1 and 3 Charge Count for +1, so using up 10 Charge gives +6 Bleed Count in total. Coin Power also rises at 10 or more Charge Count.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「重い衝突」は使用時と的中時に計4、S2「壊す」は使用時と的中: **Gaining Charge**: S1 Weighty Bash grants 4 Charge Count in total on use and on hit, and S2 Demolish grants 8 in total on use and on hit. The Defense skill Bioelectricity Induction grants Charge Count when he takes damage while he has Shield.
messages.硬さと挑発: 防御レベルは人格Lv+5。バトルパッシブ「rrR-#4スーツ加圧稼: **Durability and Aggro**: His Defense Level is Identity Lv +5. Through the combat passive Activate rrR-#4 Suit Pressurization (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), his rightmost slot gains +3 Aggro if he has at least 5 Charge Count at Turn Start.
messages.速度強化(おまけ): 同じパッシブで、ターン終了時に充電回数5につき次のターンの: **Speed boost (minor)**: The same passive grants +2 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Charge Count at Turn End, up to 6. At 7 or more Speed, S1 deals +25% damage and S2 adds +1 Bleed Count. However, his base Speed is a slow 2–5, so it is hard to achieve on purpose.
messages.サポートパッシブ「機動訓練」(嫉妬×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間、: **Support passive — Maneuver Training (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, at Turn End, the 1 ally with the highest Charge Count gains +1 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Charge Count, up to 3.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を10以上貯め、S3で出血回数を一気に増やして、出血を扱う味: Build 10 or more Charge Count with S1 and S2, then use S3 to raise Bleed Count all at once, laying the groundwork for Bleed allies' damage. His high Defense Level and Aggro let him take attacks while building Charge.
